spell.druids.heavy_strike.name: Heavy Strike
spell.druids.heavy_strike.description: Strike an enemy for {damage} physical damage, knocking them back greatly.
spell.druids.spectral_goat.name: Rampaging Spirit
spell.druids.spectral_goat.description: Summon the rampaging spirit of an ancestral goat. The goat will follow an enemy target if it has one, acting unpredictably otherwise. It deals negligible damage on impact but high knockback.
spell.druids.ancestral_totem.name: Ancestral Totem
spell.druids.ancestral_totem.description: Summon forth an ancestral totem that gathers the spirits of your ancestors to guard it. Nearby enemies attract ancestors that slam them, dealing {damage} physical damage in an area.
spell.druids.ancestral_avatar.name: Ancestral Avatar
spell.druids.ancestral_avatar.descriptio: You soul ignites your nearby Ancestral Totems, dealing 10%% of the totem's maximum life as soul damage in an area, destroying the totem. Gain Ancestral Avatar for eight seconds, gaining 20%% more physical damage per totem destroyed this way.
spell.druids.galvanize.name: Arc
spell.druids.galvanize.description: {damage} Lightning Damage. Launch arcing lightning energy forward, chaining twice. When chaining, up to two lesser chains hit the closest eligible enemies, which cannot chain further.
spell.druids.jolt.name: Jolt
spell.druids.jolt.description: {heal} Lightning-based Healing. Infuse a target with invigorating electric energies, healing them them while giving them Haste and Spell Haste based on your lightning power. Chains similarly to Arc.
spell.druids.spiderlightning.name: Soul Spark
spell.druids.spiderlightning.description: {damage_1} Lightning | {damage_2} Soul. Unleash a torrent of unpredictable sparks that move erratically in a general direction.
spell.druids.chain.name: Galvanic Contagion
spell.druids.chain.description: {damage_1} Lightning | {damage_2} Soul | {damage_3} Arcane. This contagion of unstable energy quickly bounces between targets, spreading like a plague.
spell.druids.voltaic_burst.name: Voltaic Burst
spell.druids.voltaic_burst.description: {damage_1} Lightning | {damage_2} Soul | {damage_3} Arcane. Developed by forgotten mage whose reach always far exceeded their grasp, this spell relies on the human desire for power to allow the user to lay waste to wherever they walk, getting stronger as they continue to cast the spell.
spell.druids.spiritbolts.name: Spirit Bolts
spell.druids.spiritbolts.description: Up to {damage_1} Soul, {damage_2} Frost, or {damage_3} Fire DPS. A staple occultist spell that either transforms or magnifies soul energy, and sends an elemental mote hurling forward many times a second.
spell.druids.stormcall.name: Storm Call
spell.druids.stormcall.description: {damage_1} Lightning | {damage_2} Soul 4 times a second. One day during a drought, the Druids had had enough. They figured the only way to make it rain was to make the gods cry.
spell.druids.soulflare.name: Soul Flare
spell.druids.soulflare.description: {damage} Soul 2 times a second. Adversaries on the receiving end of this spell have been reported to never return, possibly having been sent hurling miles away.
spell.druids.tendrils.name: Storm Surge
spell.druids.tendrils.description: Channel to smite enemies in front of you, having less chance to work per enemy over 4 in the area. Deals 1.5x Lightning and Arcane DPS.
spell.druids.lightningblast.name: Soul Smite
spell.druids.lightningblast.description: {damage_1} Lightning | {damage_2} Soul. Turn the divines' ire onto a single point, decimating a single target. May repeat a variable amount of times.
spell.druids.galvanic_rite.name: Soul Shock
spell.druids.galvanic_rite.description: Blast an enemy with arcane energy for 0.45x Soul and Arcane, gaining 1 stack of Lightning Power for 10 seconds, up to 5.
spell.druids.maelstromtotem.name: Maelstrom Totem
spell.druids.maelstromtotem.description: {damage_1} Soul | {damage_2} Frost | {damage_3} Fire 4 times a second. An effigy of the everlasting Maelstrom is conjured at a spot of your choosing, submitting the area to the elements.
spell.druids.soulfirebastion.name: Soulfire Bastion
spell.druids.soulfirebastion.description: {damage} Fire Damage. Aetherial Druids have learned to project a mind barrier, while retaliating against enemies once the barrier is depleted.
